title: Restriction to a localized site commutes with the sheaf tensor product
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and $U$ an object of $\mathcal C$. Let $(\mathcal C/U,\mathcal O_U)$ be the localized ringed site and $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F|_U$ restriction of sheaves of modules to it [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with sheaf tensor products as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], there is an isomorphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_U$-modules
$$
(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G)|_U\cong\mathcal F|_U\otimes_{\mathcal O_U}\mathcal G|_U,
$$
natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$, which for every object $V\to U$ of $\mathcal C/U$ and all $x\in\mathcal F(V)$, $y\in\mathcal G(V)$ sends the image of $x\otimes y$ under the sheafification unit on $\mathcal C$ to the image of $x\otimes y$ under the sheafification unit on $\mathcal C/U$. No finiteness or flatness hypothesis is imposed.
